Examiner:- Verify test assignment Expired popup and click "YES" button will open "Create a Report" pop up
Examiner:- Verify "Expired" status turns to "Closed" and subscription subtest count is increased, Also verify Hovertext on "Earlier Date of testing"
Examiner:- Verify test assignment line has gone to its inactive state and "generate reports" icon is visible at Examinee management page

Examiner:- Verify Delete Test Assignment functionality "Inprogress" When clicked "No"
Examiner:- Verify Delete Test Assignment functionality "Inprogress" When clicked "Proceed"
Examiner:- Verify Delete Test Assignment functionality is not visible for "Submitted"
